PURPOSE

Test the architecture against a second substantial narrative before making story-independent claims. The fixture must be structurally distinct from War of the Ghosts and exercise different topology, pagination, missingness, or relation density.

ACCEPTANCE

- The story, addresses, semantics, derived views, outcomes, and evidence live in storymodel4s or another authorized provider; StoryAtlas contains no copied canonical story text or story-specific inference.
- The same edition compiler, pagination, static preview, interactive app, navigation index, lowering, and receipt paths work without story-specific branches.
- The fixture exercises at least two materially different structural conditions such as longer pagination, denser cross-page relations, partial chronology, missing feature coverage, repeated recalls, or alternative alignments.
- Determinism, identity, provenance, textual-twin, no-silent-layer-loss, keyboard, non-colour, 200 percent zoom, and direct-file publication courts pass for both narratives.
- Any observed limitation is recorded as a bounded issue rather than hidden by fixture-specific geometry.

2026-09-22 WORKSPACE DESIGN CATALOG
Governing implementation design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md; granular crosswalk is section 10.3. Live Mote owns status. Existing scientific/static acceptance remains in force.
Retain substantial fixture admission; M1 miniature does not satisfy it. Rich source-only qualification is bd-01M35A7CYNA8C2B3DV534449E3 and consumes this fixture evidence; fixture creation/science remains upstream.
